limitations: Search ranking and popularity filter intentionally select successes; no population estimate.
Views are cumulative displayed platform counts, not unique people, qualified traffic or organic-only reach.
Latest search returned posts outside requested dates. Date membership is checked from DOM timestamps; these comparisons are younger and are not valid matched controls.
Replies excluded from ordinary-post comparison. No normalized exposure window, follower baseline, paid-promotion status, or full distribution graph.
Public evidence consists of links, short original summaries and visible metric labels; screenshots/raw page text remain private.
Agent verification is distinct from human_checked and does not promote existing DB originals or formulas.
